notes.subject: feat(chat): fork a conversation into a new tab with /fork
notes.summary: Adds a /fork slash command that copies an idle chat's transcript, mode, model and skills into a new independent tab, in VS Code chat and the browser workspace via a new /api/tabs/fork route.PR-free of approvals and checkpoints.</parameter>
